title: Yeager International Airport unveils pre-security renovations - NewsBreak
text: CHARLESTON, WV (WOWK) – Renovations and upgrades to West Virginia International Yeager Airport’s pre-security terminal area will be beginning soon. Paige Withrow, CRW’s Chief Marketing Officer, said the upgrades include replacing ticketing counters, installing digital display signs, new flooring and updating lighting throughout the main lobby. She said that you’ll be able to notice the difference as soon as you walk through the doors. “This will really get passengers excited for what’s to come in the future for the whole terminal. This will give you just a little taste of what everything’s going to look like. This will enhance the terminal from the curb, the moment you walk in, so we’re very excited about these renovations,” Withrow said. This $8 million investment is being made possible thanks to a grant by the Federal Aviation Administration Airport Terminals Program. Renovations will include the ticket lobby, the ramp area near the secure area exit, baggage claim and all public circulation spaces in between, according to a press release sent out by CRW. Construction on the renovations is planned to begin in early October and is expected to last around four months. Withrow is asking for the public’s patience while renovations are underway. “We really just want to thank our passengers for the patience that they’ve had while we’re doing the current renovations from the bathroom to the addition of the second baggage belt. So please just be patient with us while we work through these renovations to enhance your next travel experience,” Withrow said.
